shared_elements: carved standing pillar/slab with figures in relief
animal rendered in bold high relief on the pillar surface
smaller figures in shallow low relief on the shaft below the high-relief animal
vertical stacking of animal motifs down the face
horizontal band separating registers (B) / horizontal shoulder of pillar (A)
justification: Both surfaces are upright carved pillars bearing a quadruped mammal in profile executed in bold high relief in the upper zone, with shallower, more schematic figural carving below on the shaft, so the register logic (heavy relief animal above, flat low-relief motifs beneath) matches closely. The differences are in the specific inventory: B carries a whole assembly — a row of three crouching animals along the top, a woven/zigzag band, a striding quadruped, small subsidiary creatures and long-necked birds — whereas A shows only a single downward-clinging animal above an isolated low-relief arm and hand, a motif with no counterpart in B.
